questions.q: Choose the correct form: “She promised ____ on time.”
questions.why: 'Promise' is followed by an infinitive. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q:
Rearrange the sentences P, Q, R and S to form a meaningful paragraph:
P. Goa soon became a major trading centre.
Q. The demand for spices grew rapidly in Europe.
R. As a result, traders sailed to India in search of them.
S. Many of them settled on the western coast.
questions.why: Cause, result, settlement, outcome; 'them' needs an antecedent. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Identify the part of speech of “book” in: “Please book a table for dinner.”
questions.why: It is the action word of the sentence. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct passive construction: “You should not ignore these symptoms.”
opts: These symptoms should not been ignored.
These symptoms should not be ignored.
These symptoms should not being ignored.
questions.why: Modal passive: modal + be + past participle. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the word closest in meaning to “cogent”:
questions.why: A cogent argument is clear, logical and convincing. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct tense: “He ______ the files when the auditor walked in.”
questions.why: An action in progress interrupted by another: past continuous. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct question tag: “I am late, ____?”
questions.why: 'I am' takes the tag 'aren’t I'. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct modal: “The form is optional; you ______ fill it in.”
questions.why: 'Need not' = no obligation; 'must not' = prohibition. GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.

questions.q: Choose the correct word: “The police tried to ____ a confession from the suspect.”
questions.why: 'Elicit' means to draw out; 'illicit' means unlawful. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the word opposite in meaning to “frugal”:
questions.why: Frugal = sparing with money; opposite: extravagant. GPSC-style practice item.
